domain: static analysis / CI lint-gate engineering (pattern-based custom lint rules and their evasion surface)
axioms: A regex- or substring-based structural check enumerates FORMS, not MEANING; any semantically-equivalent form outside the enumerated set is invisible to it
A check's walked-roots list is a closed set; anything constructed, templated, generated, or vendored outside it is unchecked by definition
Developers route around a gate that produces false positives faster than they fix the gate, so a suppression mechanism -- formal or ad hoc -- is a de facto part of every static check's real behavior
A check that is not wired into a blocking CI step is advisory regardless of how correct its logic is
Cross-language codebases need per-language pattern sets; a pattern tuned for shell/jq syntax has no purchase on equivalent Python or other-language constructs
failure_mode: does not evaluate whether the underlying session-identity semantics the check protects are themselves correct, only whether the check can be gamed
not positioned to judge the rig check's git-blob-hashing correctness or drift severity policy
may flag theoretical evasion paths that are unlikely given this specific team's actual contribution patterns
